tools.name: get_integration_guide
tools.description: Returns the step-by-step guide to add custom domain connection to a project with Cnamio: records, environment variables, server session route, browser connect window, headless API and webhook verification (Node.js and Python). Start here when integrating Cnamio into code.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Read-only. Finds where a domain's DNS is hosted and how it can be connected: provider, setupType, connectMethods (api_token when the records can be created with the user's provider token), nameservers, recordState for a single CNAME, and conflicts with records already published.

tools.name: connect_domain
tools.description: Starts a manual connection: returns the exact records the domain owner must create at their DNS provider and starts watching propagation on the authoritative nameservers (up to 72 hours). Does not change DNS. Follow it with get_connection_status.

tools.name: connect_domain_automatic
tools.description: Creates the records at the domain's DNS provider with an API token the domain owner provides (only when check_domain returned connectMethods containing api_token). The token is used during this call only and is never stored; existing records are never changed or deleted (a conflict returns 409 with

tools.name: get_connection_status
tools.description: Status of a connection: pending, in_progress, completed (connected) or failed (72 hours without propagation).

tools.name: recheck_propagation
tools.description: Asks Cnamio to check the domain's authoritative nameservers again now (at most once every 5 minutes per connection).

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: Recent connections of the application, newest first, optionally for one domain or status. Needs the application credentials (not a session token).
